snippet.title: Ire: A Prologue - Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
WHAT IF HIDE AND SEEK WAS LIFE AND DEATH?
It’s 1986, and you're stranded on a ship in the Bermuda Triangle. Everyone is missing — but you’re not alone. You’re trapped in a terrifying loop with a monster, and you’ll have to stay one step ahead to survive. Ready or not, here it comes.

NOSTALGIA HORROR
A love letter to 80’s and 90’s horror, Ire: A Prologue immerses you in a haunting story from a young teenager’s perspective, inviting you to experience a dark world through the lens of her innocence and imagination— one loop at a time.

THE START OF A NEW HORROR FRANCHISE
This is just the beginning. Ire: A Prologue sets up the deep story behind the many mysteries that await in the Ire franchise. Emily’s story kicks off a chain of events that will forever change the world as we know it. Can you survive long enough to uncover the truth?
